title: Dead-End Corridor Observation Posts in Early Roguelike Corridor Combat

when_to_avoid: All exits drop you adjacent with no retreat corridor.

prerequisites: At least one identified dead-end or pocket near a dangerous room.
success: Execute pre-mapped corridor retreat when adjacency occurs.
failure: Get trapped behind pet or in cul-de-sac with advancing threats.
Pet dies while you are still near dangerous room with no alternative position.

runs.description: Eastern kobold/0 dead-end post let the Knight anchor while the pet chipped the blob, then retreat west when adjacency hit; western 3-sided pocket served as the safer follow-up anchor after a pet-block message; the run was deliberately quit on DL1 once these posts and a central-corridor negative case were documented.
